question: Simplification of (0.2 times 0.2+0.02 times 0.02-0.4 times 0.02)/(0.36) gives:
solution:
**Given:**

(0.2 times 0.2+0.02 times 0.02-0.4 times 0.02)/(0.36)

**Calculation:**

⇒ (0.2 times 0.2+0.02 times 0.02-0.4 times 0.02)/(0.36) 

= (0.04+0.0004-0.008)/(0.36)

⇒ (0.0324)/(0.36)=0.09

**Therefore, the simplified value of the expression is 0.09**
